_readme: Measured in a real browser by build/measure_labels.py. Keys under widths are font-size/font-weight, with +caps where the stylesheet uppercases and letter-spaces the text. A value is the WIDEST width the string takes across every family in the site's font stack that this machine can resolve, not the width on this machine's own resolution: the layout has to hold on a viewer's machine too. Families the machine does not hold cannot be measured and are not covered; see probes, where families sharing a probe width are the same face. Committed so the build is deterministic and needs no browser. Regenerate with python3 build/measure_labels.py.

10/400.note: node labels and their wrap candidates, .node .lbl

9/400.note: edge verb chips and node marks, .chip-tx
